style: Flat matte 2D game sprite art for a calm wordless Finnish mobile game, using 1930s Finnish functionalist shape language: smooth free-form curves, and bent laminated birch plywood edges shown as two to four thin parallel offset lines following each curved top edge. Large flat colour shapes with at most one soft tonal step, crisp clean edges, no outlines, no brush texture, no paper grain, no 3D render, no glossy or plastic highlights, no photorealism, no clay or plush look. Palette: kaamos blue #1E3150, frost #9DB9CC, birch white #F2EEE6, birch ply #E2C79C, ply edge #B48E5C, spring green #9DBE8C, spruce #2F4A48, granite #8A8F9C. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signature, no watermark, no faces, no red.
isolated: Isolated elements on a fully transparent background, orthographic side view. Paint them in their natural local colours at middle value under soft even overcast daylight: no cast shadows, no light sources, no glow, no night or sunset tint, muted slightly desaturated colours, because the game adds darkness, light and colour grading in code. Nothing else in the image beyond what is named: no ground, no sky, no backdrop, no frame, no vignette, no border.

assets.name: concept/concept_final_keeper_sheet
assets.prompt: Character sheet of one character in four poses in one row, evenly spaced, all facing right, identical size, proportions and colours, seen exactly from the side: (1) standing still, (2) sliding standing on its feet, leaning forward, cloak streaming back, (3) crouched low pressing down, cloak tucked tight, (4) sitting on the ground with the lantern set down beside it. The only character is the Keeper: a small, round, child-sized figure about half as wide as it is tall, wrapped in a felted wool cloak the colour of birch plywood #E2C79C with a soft kaamos-blue shadow side; a smooth dome-shaped hood that is perfectly round on top (no point, no tip, no ears, no pompom, no fur trim) flowing straight into a cloak that flares gently into a bell shape down to the ground; a hem band of two thin darker ply lines #B48E5C near the bottom of the cloak; no scarf. The figure is seen from the side or slightly from behind so no face is ever visible, the hood opening is not shown. One small mitten holds a small round lantern on a short handle at hip height. The lantern glass is dark and unlit.

assets.name: concept/concept_final_props_sheet
assets.prompt: Four props in one row, evenly spaced, side view, all standing on the same invisible base line: (1) a small Finnish log sauna hut with thick snow on the roof whose curved snow edge shows thin ply lines, one small square window that is dark and unlit; (2) a cluster of three slender white birches with short dark lenticel dashes and fine bare twigs; (3) a slender birch-white day-mark tower with a small round dark unlit lamp room on top, no stripes, no bands, standing on a smooth rounded granite base; (4) a cairn of three smooth rounded stacked stones.
